# Bhaskar Pathak

> Bhaskar Pathak designs and builds distinctive websites for design-led small businesses, working directly with owners in the US, UK and India.

Canonical website: https://bhaskarjyotipathak.in
Contact: hello@bhaskarjyotipathak.in
GitHub: https://github.com/Bhaskar-J-Pathak

## Services

- New websites for studios, consultants and service businesses
- Focused redesigns when a strong business is being undersold by its current website
- Responsive development from an existing design
- Visual direction, interaction design and frontend development

## Selected work

- Rajdhany Realtors: client work for a luxury real estate business
  Case study: https://bhaskarjyotipathak.in/work/rajdhany-realtors
- Xvault Studio: founder-led writing software product
  Case study: https://bhaskarjyotipathak.in/work/xvault-studio
- Spylt: independent Awwwards-style CPG website study, not commissioned by or affiliated with SPYLT
  Case study: https://bhaskarjyotipathak.in/work/spylt-study
- Lucas Danielsson: client portfolio for a Swedish magician
  Case study: https://bhaskarjyotipathak.in/work/lucas-danielsson

## Working relationship

Bhaskar handles website direction, design and development directly. He is based in India and works remotely with US and UK call hours. He has more than four years of experience.
